brands.name: Neilson Surfboards
brands.short_description: Tom Neilson has shaped nearly 8,000 boards over 30+ years in Cocoa Beach, Florida — from classic longboards and fish to high-performance shortboards and specialty shapes.

models.name: Dreamsicle
models.description: Features a smooth flowing concave in the nose that is not excessive but just right for the moderate nose rocker in this board. This transitions to a flat then to a perfectly balanced spiral vee in the last 1/3 of the board. The tail rocker is a geometrically accelerating curve which means it helps the board turn quickly. The tail rocker is not excessive or gimmicky which can make a board stall in a cutback forcing a rider to make herky jerky tail turns in order to quickly move forward and avoid a stall. This tail rocker keeps it all flowing and literally going. The overall rocker in this board allows you to turn from the nose, the mid section or more quickly from the tail. There are no "dead spots" that you have to quickly move through in order to avoid stopping or falling over dead in the water! The rails are old school 60/40 soft, full and buttery in the chest and mid section which keeps the boards speed up, paddle really good, and allows the board to be responsive to turning and forgiving at the same time. All the pieces of the Dreamsicle fit together to make an exceptionally fun riding all around dream to ride longboard.

models.name: Pintastic
models.description: A modern finely tuned progressive longboard. Features a slightly wider, deeper concave nose with specific rail shape for holding the nose in on a steeper face for ease of locking in solid nose rides. It’s a real performance longboard with decades of shaping experience dialing in this proven shape that is meant to be playful under your feet with a full panel Vee bottom, spiral Vee tail with an imbedded light 2x concave along with a geometrically accelerating tail rocker. The wider hip helps you nose ride when the tail is buried under the breaking wave and the rocker and pin tail helps hold you in on better surf days or set you up for the 1,2,3 nose ride if so desired. The rail plan shape is modern progressive soft box rails except in the fin area where it has short board edges to keep the speed up through power turns for those big buckets, full speed short boarder style power cut backs. It’s all there, there in this must have all around modern longboard. models.name: Classic
models.description: The Classic Longboard - 60/40 rails, panel vee, flowing nose concave and a clean template make for a beautiful classic that you can be proud of and keep for years of surfing pleasure.

models.name: The Perch
models.description: At 9'2 the dimensions are 9'2 x 23" x 2 7/8" but can be custom ordered in sizes from 9' to 10'. This board is a nod back to the classic longboards in trying to keep things true to form. Glassing combines E-glass and volan deck knee patches and bottom tail patches to give you a perfect balance of strength and weight that is not too heavy but keeps that classic look. It's a classic noserider with a very lively feel under your feet. Recommended fin is a 9.6" or 10.0" Saxon Wilson fin by Rainbow Fin Co, or if more tip size or stability is needed the 9.5 "El Gato" by Rainbow Fin Co. The Perch was developed with team rider Saxon Wilson to pair him with a board that was an authentic classic nose riding longboard. His feedback has been instrumental in the improvement of this shape to make it such a great all around longboard.

models.name: The Buzz
models.description: The Buzz model is a pure high performance longboard made for surfing hollow beach break and waves with power. The board has a normal thickness of 2 7/8 but the rails are foiled in such a way that the rail engages the wave and does not spin out for deep powerful bottom turns. Its fast, to make sections and make it out of tube rides. If you want a longboard that is a refined high performance board then this is the board for you. models.name: Right Coast Cruiser
models.description: Flatter rocker, sweet flowing nose concave and specialized secret concaves and vee's with a traditional square tail create the perfect shread sled for Right Coast waves.

models.name: Levitation
models.description: This board is called the Levitation because it nose rides incredibly well. The board features a very unique bottom with no nose concave, but has low entry rocker/rail shape to facilitate nose riding. The entire bottom shape of the rails and tail curve rocker are all very specific to this model. It’s a high-performance retro longboard shape allowing you to do cutting edge long boarding to your hearts desire. models.name: Alchemist
models.description: The Alchemist model is a copy of a 1966 board re-imagined for Alex Wilson. It came out so good, Alex said it rode better than the one he got from a California shaper. Which is quite the compliment coming from him. The original model was made in 1966 by Hap Jacobs and Dale Velzy. It was called the 422 and in that period it was all about nose riding. My version is a more polished and tuned board made with modern blanks and materials. This board is not for everyone and you really need to be a more experienced Surfer, who wants a really unique different board that does two things really well: 1. A deep swing weight bottom turn that allows you to set up 2. a hang ten nose ride It features a bent wing hip, deep step deck tail a less noticeable step deck square nose. The bottom features a pronounced nose concave that runs back into the middle of the board complemented by the step deck tail, the boards bent wing hip, Vee and tail rocker. These unique features allow an experienced rider step back and sink and turn the tail in a dramatic way which is what sets up a beautiful nose ride. The rails are 50/50 staying true to this periods roots. If you want a good paddling, floaty, somewhat quirk ish longboard that once mastered creates amazing rides this may be your ticket to fun!

models.name: Flying Floatey Fish
models.description: The Flying Floatey Fish is one of the most popular boards in the Neilson lineup and for good reason. This board is a wave-catching machine. The best way to improve your surfing is to catch more waves and the Floatey Fish is the board for this.

models.name: Super Squash
models.description: The Neilson Surfboards Super Squash is a small wave groveler that is designed with the wide point forward to give you excellent paddling and wave entry

models.name: Summer Fish
models.description: The Summer Fish was my personal board that my friend Kyle got to ride when he was visiting from California. He liked it so much that he got me to ship it to him in California where he rides it to this day. This is a really clean no nonsense board that well keep you stoked on surfing for years to come without any fancy wings, channels or other gimmicks. Ride it as a quad which helps keep it fast and loose at the same time. Get the latest info on new models , swag and current inventory . Just enter your email address and click "Sign Up".

models.name: Classic Fish
models.description: The Classic Fish is an original old school template with straighter hips and super modern vee and concaves to create one of the fastest boards you will ever ride.

models.name: 3X Pro
models.description: The 3X Pro is a highly refined performance shortboard for those wishing to really push their surfing ability. The 3X Pro is highly responsive and finely tuned for tight turns in the pocket.

models.name: DWRT
models.description: The speed and paddling power of the Flying Floaty Fish, but with the double wing round tail (DWRT). This creates a board that is fast and yet with the pulled in tail allows you to surf in more hollow or powerful waves. The DWRT is a great choice to add to your quiver to have a flexible, versatile board that will allow you to have fun in knee high summer surf or overhead hurricane swell. There is a lot to be said to having 1 board that can do it all. If you want to catch a ton of waves, have more fun and improve your surfing, the DWRT is the board to have in your quiver. Available with thruster, quad or five fin, choose your favorite fin setup and get out there and have fun! Get the latest info on new models , swag and current inventory . Just enter your email address and click "Sign Up".

models.name: Pro Grom II
models.description: A scaled down shape for the young grom who wants to take his surfing to the next level. The Pro Grom II is great for speed, airs and solid snaps. A clean outline, thin rails. The Pro Grom II comes standard with a squash tail but can be custom ordered with any tail shape your prefer. Typically ridden as a thruster but available in a quad or five-fin convertible setup as well. Get the latest info on new models , swag and current inventory . Just enter your email address and click "Sign Up".

models.name: The Roundo
models.description: The Roundo has a ton of drive and rides well in the best hollow surf or can grovel the smaller stuff with the best of them. This is great all-around board and a great option if you want maximum range out of a single board.

models.name: The Boost
models.description: Developed with the Pro team rider David Aubrey. The average surfer loves the insane speed and vertical turns, the pros love the chunky gaffs and the ballistic airs the speed allows you to readily create.

models.name: The Boss
models.description: This board fills that gap by creating a board that is not super boaty and thick but is not a super chip. It is based on the same profile and bottom concaves as my team riders have but just a thicker version. Usually you get this in epoxy to give you that extra 15% float versus a normal poly board. These boards go vertical, make late take offs and travel well to any waves in the world and still charge in overhead powerful waves. This is the board for the surfer who is in shape but wants a real board for real surfing and still have decent float and paddle power. This model has been proven to work in good surf here in Florida and all over the world. Normally ridden as a thruster. Size Range - 175 to 195 lbs : 6'2" x 19 3/4" x 2 5/8" squash tail For every 25-35 lbs, increase the width 1/4" and the length by 1" to 2", keeping the thickness the same. models.name: Mini-Gun
models.description: Hurricane Season or a trip to Central America calls for the addition of a Mini Gun to your quiver. In waves of consequence you need the right board for the job and this is it. Get in early and pull in deep.

models.name: Venturi Vee
models.description: The Venturi Vee is super fast, especially the better the waves get, the faster it goes. It's a great travel board as it has the retro front half for float and paddle power and from the wide point back it is a modern short board. It features a light concave to a vee set inside two more pronounced double concaves in the last 1/3 of the board. This board creates tons of drive and is extremely fast and well suited to solid surf and powerful surfing. It's a good travel board as it has the retro front half for float and paddle power and then from the wide point back to the tail it is a modern short board. Consider this a modern retro shape. models.name: Gemini Twin
models.description: This is a really good mid length twin fin with nice foiling in the last half of the board for quick precise turning. It has a third fin box for a nubster or smaller fin for really hollow conditions but with the outside fin’s set farther back it is rarely needed with proper modern twin fins. Fast, fun and decent float under the chest it's a wave catching machine to keep you salty. Recommended fins FCS II- Power twin plus one Rainbow Fin Co. - "Fish Twin" 5.25 As a single fin Rainbow Fin Co. - 7” MD3 Flex FCS II - 7” MID single

models.name: The Mango
models.description: This model originally started out as a custom board for a crypto currency private label display board. I hand shaped two boards and liked it so much after shaping that I shaped one for myself too. Then rode it in gutless small waves in Cocoa Beach and it just tore it up! It caught waves easily, turned really good and made surfing really fun. I had the board I was riding scanned by the computer cad machine and then hand finish each one personally to make sure it is refined and perfect like the original. The original is 6' x 20" x 2 5/16". I like mine in poly using US blanks foam and normal 6/4 deck and a 4 bottom giving good flex qualities. I have ridden this board in knee high to overhead and it excels in all conditions and is also really predictable in better more hollow or powerful waves which is a plus. The Mango is a good all around groveler and go to versatile shortboard! Available in eps/epoxy or good ol' fashioned poly. Available 5'2" - 6'6" in size. models.name: Soul (Eggo)
models.description: The Soul is a classic wide-point forward single fin. Lots of volume and low rocker make this a fast, wave catching machine. A totally different approach than the modern shortboard. Mix it up a bit and see how fun single fins can be!

models.name: The Blunt
models.description: The Blunt is all about catching waves and having fun. Lots of width and volume in a shorter package allow you to paddle easily and catch any the slightest ripple that pops up and ride it however you want.

models.name: Kracken
models.description: This is a state of the art board inspired by a team riders travels to Oahu. This is shaped to be a modern fuller shape in nose and tail that also allows you to ride bigger more powerful waves and not give up paddle power like you do when you ride a chippy short board or mini gun. You can ride this in a shorter range depending on your height or weight (5'8" to 6'4") with normal lengths being 5'10" to 6'0" for someone around 175 pounds. It features a progressive double concaves and specialized vee. This model has been proven in Hawaii and in heaving point breaks and rock breaks in South America and yes, even good days here in Florida which we do occasionally get! Get the latest info on new models , swag and current inventory . Just enter your email address and click "Sign Up".

models.name: Cheetah
models.description: It's considered cheating if you are a die hard short boarder to ride a board with hidden extra foam in it that lets you catch more waves! It's the Cheetah model because - well it’s just crazy fast and goes around sections other boards get stuck behind! My friend Rick had me make the original board as he wanted a more pointed nose that included performance rails, refined concave bottom (speed) and still had good floatation hidden in the middle!

models.name: Mini Ripper
models.description: This board is all about Summer time fun in a mid range mini longboard shape. Semi pointed nose for punching through waves and a fuller more longboard nose for cheating five or getting you in the wave early. The round pin will not spin out on those better days and also keeps it loose when the waves are slower and more playful. The bottom features a really cool mini nose concave and a flowing bottom with a light spiral vee for speed and features a refined performance rail for real surfing and yet with the width and thickness for good flotation at the same time.

models.name: Sting Fun
models.description: The sting in the funshape outline allows the board to ride like a fun shape when you are farther forward and then by sliding your back foot over the tail to turn it more like a shortboard. Lots of drive and tight turns for it's size.

models.name: HP Fun
models.description: This model lets you take a board reserved for cruising and learning and turns it into a board the experienced surfer can rip on. Good to have in anyones quiver for the slower hard to catch waves or those good days where it is a longer period swell.
